data.action: 跪坐茶席前，研墨的手微顿
data.description: 【夕 · 煮茶研墨】古朴清幽的茶席前，红泥小火炉上的清泉正咕嘟作响。夕跪坐于竹席上，研墨的纤细玉手微微一顿，将一盏泛着墨香的春茶推到你的面前——「尝尝看吧，这是取画中雪水煮的雨前茶。哼，要是敢说不好喝，下次就只能喝砚台里的墨汁了。」
data.promptProse: Dusk kneels on the bamboo mat beside the veranda tea table, pausing her ink-grinding hand over the inkstone while spring tea steams at the opposite place. Ink-black qipao and gradient wide sleeves gather naturally around the seated pose. The medium close-up includes brushwork, cup and inkstone with the courtyard beyond. Soft courtyard daylight reveals the robe's teal motifs and inkstone sheen, leaving small utensil shadows along the textured mat.
data.title: 夕 · 煮茶研墨
